title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 19.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an unauthenticated user to read files from a private project repository. This occurs due to missing authorization checks in snippets. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
